constraints: This is a DRAFT for independent review, not a Coordinator decision that amends H-CREP-001. Do not change H-CREP-001's status, do not change EXP-CREP-001's specification, do not create B71, BATCH, IDEA, EV, DEC, CORR, experiment, or implementation records.

The draft must make an explicit CHOICE among the disclosed ambiguities from the three prior rounds (one-pair vs. two-pairs deck structure being the most consequential, since it changes the predicted degree by a full exponent), with a stated justification for the choice -- not merely restate that both remain possible. If no principled basis for choosing can be found, say so explicitly and draft the definition parametrically (stating both options precisely, with the discharge map showing what would need to be true for each) rather than picking arbitrarily.

The definition must be checked item-by-item against RT103-C1's exact stated requirements (self-contained definitions of g_I, r_R, z_R, charts, saturations, multiplicities, strata, and a proof of exact support) in the required rt103-c1-discharge-map.yaml deliverable -- an item that cannot be discharged must be named explicitly as an open gap, not silently omitted.

The definition must be compatible with everything H-CREP-001.yaml and EXP-CREP-001/specification.yaml actually DO say (it may not contradict the one sentence of mechanism that does exist, or the frozen instance parameters), and must explain its relationship to the frozen EXP-CREP-001 engine's own behavior (independently characterized in DEC-20260830-6f28e0 and DEC-20260830-680f6d) -- if the new definition implies the frozen engine's Theta(B^3) measurement or its absent decomposition should be read differently, say so explicitly as a consequence, not silently.
No commands, programs, experiments, benchmarks, or computer algebra system execution. This is a mathematical drafting task.
Citation provenance is mandatory. Every source carries recalled | retrieved | kb | internal.

Write the three substantive artifacts first and runtime-session-receipt.json last. Do not alter any input, goal, ledger, prior pre-admission, prior round, or queue file. YAML hygiene is mandatory and will be independently re-checked with a strict parser (Gate 6): no plain scalar may contain an embedded, unescaped double-quote or a colon-followed-by-space -- wrap the ENTIRE scalar in single quotes if either is needed. No duplicated top-level keys at any nesting level, and no bare mapping key inside a block sequence without a leading '-'. This defect class has broken artifacts in four of the last seven rounds; check every free-text field and every list line by line before finishing.

completion_gate: Gate 1: the candidate definition is self-contained and specific enough that RT103-C1's requirements can be checked against it item by item, without relying on external inference or the reader's own reconstruction.

Gate 2: an explicit choice (or an explicit parametric statement of the unresolved alternatives, if no choice was principled) is made among the disclosed one-pair/two-pairs ambiguity, with stated justification either way.
Gate 3: every RT103-C1 item is addressed in rt103-c1-discharge-map.yaml as discharged, partially discharged, or open, with no item silently omitted.

Gate 4: the definition is checked for compatibility with everything H-CREP-001.yaml and EXP-CREP-001/specification.yaml actually state, and its relationship to the frozen engine's independently-characterized behavior is made explicit.
Gate 5: no B71, experiment, implementation, status transition, or claim beyond a reviewable draft is created or asserted; H-CREP-001's status and EXP-CREP-001's specification are unchanged.

Gate 6: every YAML artifact parses under a strict, unforgiving parser (no embedded unescaped quotes in plain scalars, no duplicated top-level keys at any nesting level, no bare mapping key inside a block sequence without a leading '-').
If any gate is unmet the task fails its completion gate and a scoped repair is taken before the review round proceeds.

review_plan.claim_under_review: The draft's own claim, as it will state it: that rcrep-candidate-definition.yaml gives one explicit, self-contained, checkable candidate definition of r_R, and that rt103-c1-discharge-map.yaml states truthfully which of RT103-C1's named requirements it discharges. The independent validator and red-team tasks named in the joints below are dispatched in a successor queue against the archived draft bytes; this plan is frozen here, before any reviewer runs.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: This Coordinator expects one of two outcomes: either the draft successfully names a self-contained, checkable definition that at least one of the two disclosed alternatives (one-pair/Theta(B^2) or two-pairs/Theta(B^4)) can be checked against directly, discharging most or all of RT103-C1's items for that alternative; or the draft itself surfaces a further layer of underspecification (e.g. the frozen instance model's B=2/3 deck structure may not even uniquely fix which decks are 'the' pair-pair decks the original sentence refers to), in which case the honest outcome is that RT103-C1 remains open pending a fresh mechanism specification from outside this analytical chain, and KN-OPEN-de67f0 should be recorded as blocked rather than further reconstructed.

joints.joint: Does the candidate definition genuinely discharge RT103-C1's support-biconditional requirement (r_R vanishes at a label if and only if it extends to a labelled pair-pair relation), or does it merely restate the definitional sentence in more symbols without proving the biconditional?
joints.attack_plan: Construct a small concrete instance (by hand, no code) where the candidate definition's stated construction is evaluated directly, and check both directions of the biconditional explicitly -- does a label that should vanish actually evaluate to a root, and does every root correspond to a genuine extension? A definition that only shows one direction, or that assumes the biconditional in its setup rather than proving it, fails this joint.

joints.joint: Is the choice between the one-pair/Theta(B^2) and two-pairs/Theta(B^4) alternatives (or the parametric statement, if no choice was made) actually justified by something in H-CREP-001.yaml, EXP-CREP-001/specification.yaml, or the original TASK-20260722-101 source text -- or is it selected because it matches the pre-existing declared Theta(B^2) figure, repeating the exact bias this Coordinator flagged in DEC-20260830-69bbf7?
joints.attack_plan: Read the justification in decision-record-among-alternatives.yaml independently of knowing which figure was 'expected,' and ask: if the declared figure in this corpus had instead been Theta(B^4), would this same justification have favored the two-pairs reading instead? If the justification would flip to match whatever figure happened to be declared, it is circular and does not actually discharge the ambiguity.

blindness.declared: The validator and red-team sessions dispatched for this draft's review must not read each other's reports, and must not read this review_plan's own attack hints beyond their assigned joint before forming their own initial assessment, to avoid anchoring on this Coordinator's specific framing of the risk.

objects: A labelled configuration built so that NO pair-pair relation extends it -- e.g. label the decks with points whose stated joint relation is unsatisfiable over the frozen EXP-CREP-001 instance field (a forced non-collinear triple, or a deck assignment excluded by the chosen chart convention). The definition's support biconditional is known false here: r_R must not vanish.

A null object of the same shape with the deck-pairing structure removed -- the same label set carried by decks between which the chosen pairing defines no relation at all, so the construction has nothing to eliminate. Any claimed vanishing locus here is an artifact of the elimination bookkeeping, not of the mechanism.

The opposite deck-structure reading (two-pairs if the draft chose one-pair, and vice versa): the draft's justification for its choice must FAIL on this object, since it asserts the other reading is wrong.
proves_too_much.failure_signature: On each object the construction must visibly refuse: r_R has no root at those labels, or the definition is undefined there and says so. If the candidate definition still yields a vanishing r_R -- or its choice justification reads equally well for the reading it rejected -- it proves too much and the biconditional is being assumed in the setup rather than established.
